rv.q: This play is, ironically, full of life, even though there are struggles and tears. I can't think of a better way to end my three-play waltz with death.
The trio of actors who bring this play to life are all incredible.

The magic of 'The Luckiest,' directed sensitively and with an eye for fine detail by Cody Estle, is that even though the first minutes of play foreshadow how the drama will unfold, it remains fully compelling, engrossing until the final, inevitable blackout.
This is 90 minutes ( no intermission) of pure magic on the stage.
